case_applicability.assessment: The original La(NO3)3 x6H2O, MediaDive1586 CAS10277-43-7, Sigma331937 and PubChem exact six-water identity agree on lanthanum(III) nitrate hexahydrate. Official NLM browser explicitly assigns CAS10277-43-7 to narrower MeSH concept M0313204, labelled lanthanide nitrate hexahydrate, under the descriptor whose synonyms include lanthanum nitrate. The exact concept preserves the six-water scope that the broader descriptor C016534 would lose. The production local adapter independently resolves the M concept canonical label; the proposal therefore uses mesh:M0313204 with CAS_RN_LOOKUP provenance and retains the CAS/form evidence. An OLS search returning only descriptor classes was insufficient to establish absence of this exact concept. The flattened producer label LaNO33 x 6 H2O is retained with its original provenance as non-resolving REJECTED_LABEL, because loss of parentheses changes literal formula stoichiometry; only the verified provider spelling is a resolving source alias.
